skill.description: Build GSAP ScrollTrigger animations with practical guidance for triggers, scrubbing, pinning, batching, smooth-scroller integration, horizontal movement, refresh behavior, and cleanup.
skill.summary: Create reliable scroll-driven animations with GSAP ScrollTrigger.

content.user_title: Build Scroll Animations with GSAP ScrollTrigger
content.value_statement: Scroll-driven interfaces can break when triggers, pinning, refresh order, or cleanup are configured incorrectly. This skill provides focused GSAP ScrollTrigger implementation guidance.
actual_capabilities: Explains plugin registration and basic ScrollTrigger configuration.
Guides start, end, scrub, pin, markers, snap, and callback settings.
Shows batching patterns for animating groups that enter or leave the viewport.
Covers scrollerProxy integration for third-party smooth-scrolling libraries.
Describes pinned horizontal movement with containerAnimation.
Provides refresh, destruction, and React cleanup guidance.
limitations: Provides implementation guidance but does not execute or visually test animations.
Assumes GSAP and ScrollTrigger are already available in the project.
Third-party smooth-scroller integrations require adaptation to each library API.
Examples may need adjustment for project layout, framework lifecycle, and accessibility requirements.

use_cases.title: Create a Product Story
use_cases.description: Build pinned, scrubbed sections that reveal product details as visitors scroll.

use_cases.title: Animate Repeated Content
use_cases.description: Batch card or gallery entrance animations while controlling stagger and reverse behavior.

use_cases.title: Maintain React Animations
use_cases.description: Structure ScrollTrigger setup, refresh logic, and cleanup around component lifecycles.

prompt_templates.title: Add a Basic Trigger
prompt_templates.prompt: Animate [selector] from [initial state] to [final state] when it reaches [viewport position]. Use GSAP ScrollTrigger.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs one scroll-triggered animation.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Scrubbed Section
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a scrubbed animation for [section]. Define practical start and end values, optional pinning, and development markers.
prompt_templates.scenario: A page needs motion linked directly to scroll progress.

prompt_templates.title: Create Horizontal Movement
prompt_templates.prompt: Design pinned horizontal movement for [content]. Include containerAnimation triggers, responsive distance calculations, refresh handling, and stated caveats.
prompt_templates.scenario: A vertical page should reveal content horizontally.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a React Integration
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my React ScrollTrigger implementation for registration, scoping, refresh timing, responsive behavior, cleanup, reduced motion, and timeline composition.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced integration needs reliability and lifecycle review.

output_examples.input: Make feature cards fade upward as they enter the viewport.
output: Use ScrollTrigger.batch for the card selector.
Animate each delivered batch with opacity, vertical movement, and a short stagger.
Set an entry threshold near the lower viewport and define reverse behavior explicitly.

output_examples.input: Pin a chapter and connect its timeline to scrolling.
output: Attach one ScrollTrigger to the parent timeline.
Use top alignment for the start and a measured scroll distance for the end.
Enable numeric scrub and pin the chapter wrapper.
Refresh after content or font changes affect layout.

output_examples.input: Stop ScrollTrigger instances after a React route change.
output: Scope animation creation to the component.
Use the GSAP React hook or a GSAP context for cleanup.
Revert the scope during unmount and refresh after the next route layout settles.

best_practices: Register ScrollTrigger once before creating any trigger.
Create triggers in page order and refresh after layout-changing content loads.
Clean up triggers when components or animated elements are removed.
anti_patterns: Do not place ScrollTrigger on a child tween inside a controlled timeline.
Do not combine scrub and toggleActions on the same trigger.
Do not leave development markers enabled in production.

faq.question: Does this skill install GSAP?
faq.answer: No. It assumes GSAP and ScrollTrigger are available and focuses on implementation guidance.

faq.question: Can it help with pinned sections?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains pin configuration, spacing behavior, wrapper usage, and common layout concerns.

faq.question: Does it cover React cleanup?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends the GSAP React hook or context-based cleanup during component unmount.

faq.question: Can it integrate a smooth-scrolling library?
faq.answer: It explains scrollerProxy requirements, but each library needs adapter code for its own getter, setter, and update APIs.

faq.question: Does it support horizontal scrolling effects?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers pinned horizontal movement and containerAnimation-based nested triggers.

faq.question: Will it test the final animation?
faq.answer: No. You must run the page, inspect markers, test responsive layouts, and verify reduced-motion behavior.
